content:
maria: noticed a customer saw a -12 provisional token line after a region handoff, causing a support ticket.
kevin: can you paste logs?
maria: logs:
2026-03-13T09:12:01Z router: session=s-901 route=us-west-1 -> eu-central-1 reason=capacity_failover
2026-03-13T09:12:01Z runtime: session=s-901 prefix_len=20 tokens_emitted=30 status=streaming
2026-03-13T09:12:02Z runtime: session=s-901 toolcall=ocr truncated=true tokens_tool=6
2026-03-13T09:12:04Z router: session=s-901 ack=resume confirmed=true
2026-03-13T09:12:04Z billing: session=s-901 provisional_delta=-12
sam: sounds like provisional was credited on origin shard but finalize happened on new shard.
kevin: yup. router overwrites route_tag during handoff; ledger keys are route_tag+prefix so we touch two shards.
irene: runtime has request-trace-id but billing doesn't use it.
ben: effect: origin shard shows negative provisional; final shard gets refund. console shows only origin negative row.
maria: short-term UX: label negative provisional rows as "pending adjustment" and link to reconcile trace. I'll PR.
kevin: short fix: router to set X-Orig-Route on handoff; ledger to use idempotency key session|prefix|orig_route to merge provisional writes.
sam: add unit test for edgecase where toolcall truncated on old shard and final ack on new shard.
irene: ensure analytics still attribute confirmed cost to final route; provenance only for dedupe.
ben: ops-bot: incident INC-2026-043 created and assigned eng-platform.
ops-bot: canary router change at 10%  logs show X-Orig-Route preserved in ~96% handoffs.
kevin: plan: router PR (1d), ledger idempotency (2d), reconcile emits final_route tag (2d), UI copy + temporary filter (1d).
maria: filing support template for affected customers.
ben: close when canary 100% and negative provisional rate <1/min.
ops-bot: INC-2026-043 status: monitoring
